_comment: Machine-readable gate for docs/WINDOWS-UPSTREAM-SYNC.md#known-upstream-regressions. The Markdown entry keeps the evidence; tools/windows/sync-inventory.ps1 and diff-guard.ps1 read this file. status 'reverted' is enforced; 'resolved' is history only.
